filters.name: OpenShift Edge Workstream - Adaptable Topology
filters.description: An OpenShift Edge utility filter to limit lists specifically to Adaptable Topology work

filters.name: OpenShift Edge Workstream - SNO
filters.description: An OpenShift Edge utility filter to limit lists specifically to SNO work
filters.jql: component in ("Installer / Single Node OpenShift", SNO) or labels in (SNO, sno)

filters.name: OpenShift Edge Workstream - TNA
filters.description: An OpenShift Edge utility filter to limit lists specifically to Two Node with Arbiter work
filters.jql: component = "Two Node with Arbiter" or labels in (TNA)

filters.name: OpenShift Edge - Bugs and CVEs
filters.description: Bugs and CVEs that affect any of the work streams in the OpenShift Edge organization
filters.jql: (project = OCPBUGS AND filter = "OpenShift Edge - Components") OR (filter = "OpenShift Edge - Core Backlog" AND type in (Bug, Vulnerability, Weakness)) OR (project = TRT and filter = "OpenShift Edge - Team Assigned")

filters.name: OpenShift Edge - Core Backlog
filters.description: All issues from the OCPEDGE and USHIFT projects

filters.name: OpenShift Edge Workstream - TNF
filters.jql: component = "Two Node Fencing" or labels in (TNF)

filters.name: OpenShift Edge Workstream - MicroShift
filters.jql: project = USHIFT or component in (MicroShift, "MicroShift / Networking", "MicroShift / Storage") OR labels in (microshift, MicroShift)

filters.name: OpenShift Edge - Labels
filters.description: Any labels  that might be relevant to Openshift Edge
filters.jql: labels in (ocpedge, ocpedge-plan, MicroShift, microshift, TNF, TNA, SNO, sno, lvms, edge-payload)

filters.name: OpenShift Edge Workstream - MicroShift to SNO
filters.jql: component = "MicroShift to SNO" or labels in (microshift-to-sno)

filters.name: OpenShift Edge - Components
filters.description: Any components that might be relevant to Openshift Edge
filters.jql: component in ("Installer / Single Node OpenShift", "Two Node with Arbiter", "Two Node Fencing", "Logical Volume Manager Storage", MicroShift, "MicroShift / Networking", "MicroShift / Storage")

filters.name: OpenShift Edge - Scrum Board
filters.jql: project in (USHIFT, OCPEDGE) OR filter = "OpenShift Edge - Core Backlog" OR filter in ("OpenShift Edge - External Projects", "OpenShift Edge - Bugs and CVEs") AND (filter = "OpenShift Edge - Team Assigned" OR (filter = "OpenShift Edge - QE Assigned" AND status in (Review, MODIFIED, ON_QA, Testing))) ORDER BY Rank ASC

filters.name: OpenShift Edge - Team Assigned
filters.description: A filter for limiting issue searches to issues assigned to OpenShift Edge Members

filters.name: OpenShift Edge - QE Assigned
filters.description: A filter for limiting issue searches to issues OpenShift Edge Members as the assigned QA Contact

filters.name: OpenShift Edge Workstream - RHEL Ticket Verification
filters.jql: (project = RHEL AND summary ~ "\\[TNF\\]" AND component = resource-agents) OR (project = OCPEDGE AND component = RHEL-Verification) order by RANK asc

filters.name: OpenShift Edge Workstream - LVMS
filters.jql: component = "Logical Volume Manager Storage" or labels in (lvms)

filters.name: OpenShift Edge - External Projects
filters.description: External Projects that OpenShift Edge team members might be contributing to
filters.jql: project in ("Cloud-native Network Functions", "Network Edge", "OpenShift Staff Engineering", "OCP Technical Release Team", "On Prem Networking", "Edge and Ecosystem Enablement", "OpenShift Core Networking", API, ETCD, OSDOCS, PERFSCALE, "Operator Runtime", "Distributed Tracing") AND filter in ("OpenShift Edge - Components", "OpenShift Edge - Labels", "OpenShift Edge - QE Assigned", "OpenShift Edge - Team Assigned")
